goal:
I'm writing about the 2010 controversy over Canada's long-form census, when Statistics Canada's chief statistician resigned. The Montreal Gazette article "StatsCan turmoil over census" is here: https://montrealgazette.com/technology/StatsCan+turmoil+over+census/3311661/story.html
How many years had his government career lasted? Please tell me where you found it.

paragraphs: he agency silently embroiled at the centre of the census debate has long been viewed as the best of its kind in the world, but observers fear government intervention could damage the impeccable methodology and autonomy for which Statistics Canada is renowned.

The agency has been thrown into turmoil by the Conservative government's decision to scrap the long-form census and replace it with a voluntary survey -a move chief statistician Munir Sheikh found so untenable, he ended a 30-year government career by resigning in protest on Wednesday.
"StatsCan is thought of as one of the best," said Kevin Milligan, an associate professor of economics at the University of British Columbia, who has worked extensively with the agency's data.
